exact_algebra.affine_extension: q_u_affine(H) = q_u_star + (u/dt) * (H-H_star), with predictor u and q_bot_star held fixed

best_supported_bounded_classification.u: finite-window inverse bottom-head sensitivity to predictor bottom flux, used as the tangent carrier of a condensed groundwater-balance response
best_supported_bounded_classification.q_u: matching recharge/balance intercept of that condensed response; not identical by definition to the accepted physical SWAP bottom-exchange flux
best_supported_bounded_classification.pair: local response condensation of the SWAP column for the groundwater equation
best_supported_bounded_classification.hcof_rhs: numerical affine representation of this condensed q_u(H) law after area and time-unit conversion

physical_balance_connection.conditional_statement: Where u*DeltaH approximates accepted SWAP storage change over the same window, q_u approximates storage-change rate plus bottom-outward rate, hence the net non-bottom contribution from the SWAP water balance.
physical_balance_connection.implication: The total q_u variation across neighbouring complete predictor trajectories can be near zero even while the production affine partial slope +u/dt is nonzero.

real_swap_evidence.MAP02: Real prescribed-head corrector bottom-outward slope has approximately the opposite sign of the production affine partial slope in the inspected local band.
real_swap_evidence.MAP03: Production u locally matches whole-column storage sensitivity in the drainage-free fixture; bottom-outward sensitivity is -u.
real_swap_evidence.MAP04_MAP05A: Different affine slope policies can reach essentially the same accepted physics while following different coupling paths; slope can function as numerical iteration policy.
real_swap_evidence.MAP07: Across neighbouring predictor trajectories q_bot variation cancels +u/dt to first order; production +u/dt is a partial, not total, q_u derivative.
real_swap_evidence.MAP09A: Under active drainage production u is close to but not exactly the accepted-corrector storage sensitivity.
real_swap_evidence.MAP10: u is window dependent and must not be treated as a universal static specific yield.

observations: u is described as an exchange/storage coefficient and Q_u as recharge.
u is derived from two SWAP predictor simulations with perturbed lower-boundary flux: u=(q2-q1)*dt/(H2-H1).
H in that derivation is the hydraulic head at the bottom of the SWAP column.
The predictor flow fixes u, calculates recharge Q_u once, then iterates MODFLOW.
The presentation distinguishes SWAP groundwater level from MODFLOW head because of resistance in the phreatic layer.
historical_design_support.authority_limit: Historical design evidence supports interpretation but does not override current typed source/contracts or establish present physical domain ownership.

forbidden_equivalences: q_u == accepted physical bottom-outward SWAP exchange
+u/dt == total derivative of historical q_u across neighbouring predictor trajectories
HCOF == physical storage merely because its dimensions contain area/time
accepted_physics_authority: real SWAP corrector response at the trial head
complete component and coupled mass balances
unresolved: Which physical control-volume/storage ownership contract should a future SWAP-MODFLOW product adopt?
Under which deployment geometry should the condensed q_u/u representation be interpreted as shared-phreatic storage/recharge, interface coupling, or only numerical response policy?
